items.period: Shang-style oracle script; modern vector redraw of a Xiaoxuetang exemplar identified as image 41.E045
items.caption: This modern redraw presents 天 in Shang oracle-script style. Paleographers interpret the graph as a standing person based on 大, with the upper mark emphasizing the head; this interpretation does not settle whether head/top or sky was the word’s earlier meaning.
items.alt: Modern vector redraw of a Shang-style oracle-script form of 天, with a marked upper stroke above a human-like figure.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page verifies the file’s identity, Shang-style label, Xiaoxuetang source exemplar, and reuse status. The form is relevant to the cited head-marked analysis; its picture itself was not visually inspected during research.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on the Commons description page; the page attributes the exemplar image to Xiaoxuetang.

limitations.text: The image is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact photograph. The original SVG link was identified on its Commons description page but failed to open directly in this session, so the image was not visually inspected.
The human-figure and marked-head account is a paleographic interpretation; it does not determine the earliest spoken sense of 天 or prove a complete semantic development from head/top to sky/heaven.
